statement.zh: 奥尔梅克是整个中美洲的「母文化」，其他早期复杂社会皆由其单向扩散而成。
statement.en: The Olmec were the mother culture of all Mesoamerica, with other early complex societies formed by one-way diffusion from them.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: mother-culture vs. sister-culture/interaction models remain debated; Rosenswig emphasizes inter-regional interaction.
